# Neon Run // Last Train

A fast, browser-playable three-lane endless runner built with a lightweight canvas renderer—no build step or external game engine required.

## Play

Open `index.html` in a browser, or serve this folder with `python3 -m http.server 3002` and visit `http://localhost:3002`.

- **← / →** or **A / D** — switch lanes
- **↑ / W** — vault barriers
- **↓ / S** — slide under signs
- **Space** — activate a charged Phase Drive to pass through hazards
- **Swipe** — move on touch screens

Collect shards to charge your Phase Drive and build your Flow Chain. Find Phase Cells, Shard Magnets, and Overclock boosts to extend your run.

<!-- omgithub:readme:start -->

content.text:
Built **Neon Run // Last Train**, a playable three-lane endless runner with a canvas-based pseudo-3D view and no build step.

It includes lane switching, jumping, sliding, hazards, shard collection, Phase Drive, Flow Chain scoring, Phase Cells, Shard Magnets, Overclock boosts, plus pause, sound, and retry controls. Keyboard and swipe controls are supported.

**Controls:** ←/→ or A/D to switch lanes, ↑/W to jump, ↓/S to slide, Space to activate a charged Phase Drive. See `README.md` for setup and play instructions.

Verified `game.js` syntax and tested desktop and mobile layouts in the browser; the browser console reported no errors. Assumed a lightweight browser game was preferable to a full 3D engine.
